usageNotes: Use this to trigger an on-demand vzdump backup of one or more guests on a specific node; it returns a UPID string (task ID) immediately — poll the task log via GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/log to track completion. Caller must have VM.Backup on the target VMs and Datastore.AllocateSpace on the backup storage; privileged params (tmpdir, dumpdir, script, job-id) are root@pam only. Either vmid, all, or pool is required to select guests — omitting all three starts the job but backs up nothing.

examples.summary: Back up a single VM (ID 101) to PBS storage using zstd compression in snapshot mode

tips: The returned UPID can be passed to GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status or /log to follow progress.
snapshot mode is the default and keeps VMs running; use stop mode only if snapshot consistency is not achievable (e.g., no guest agent).
remove defaults to true — existing backups on the target storage will be pruned per prune-backups; set remove=false to retain all previous backups.
bwlimit, performance, and ionice require Sys.Modify on / — non-root API tokens without that privilege must omit these parameters.
fleecing (VM only) offloads dirty-block tracking to a separate storage, reducing I/O impact on production; specify a fast scratch storage via fleecing=enabled=1,storage=<id>.
mailto and mailnotification are deprecated; prefer notification-mode=notification-system and configure notification targets in the PVE notification panel.
